core_meaning.short_meaning: Tranquility; name of Sukayna bint al-Husayn
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sukayna (سكينة) is a feminine name meaning “tranquility” or “calm”, from the root س ك ن. The related Qur'anic word sakīnah denotes the tranquility God sends down upon believers (9:26, 48:4). The personal name is associated with Sukayna bint al-Husayn, a granddaughter of the Prophet.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The root س ك ن gives sakana (“to be still, dwell”) and sakīnah (“tranquility”). The Qur'an uses sakīnah for the calm sent down upon believers. Sukayna is a feminine diminutive personal name; the record distinguishes the Qur'anic word from the later personal name.
